title: Access Dental Management breach exposes health and SSN data of 341,049 people
date_note: Disclosed November 17; the intrusion happened between May 1 and May 4, 2026, and was discovered on May 5.
summary: Texas-based dental services provider Access Dental Management disclosed that attackers accessed its network between May 1 and 4 and copied names, addresses, dates of birth, Social Security numbers, medical and health insurance information. It notified the Texas and Vermont attorneys general that 341,049 people were affected; reports say the total could pass 455,000. The WorldLeaks group claimed the intrusion on June 5.
plain: A dental group in Texas says hackers took patients' personal, medical and insurance details, including Social Security numbers, for about 341,000 people.
exec: Large health-data breach at a private-equity-owned dental group; identity-theft risk for patients and regulatory exposure for the provider.
action: If you are an Access Dental Management patient, watch for its notification letter, review explanation-of-benefits forms and consider a credit freeze; partners should confirm what data they share with ADM.
impact: Personal, medical and insurance data of at least 341,049 people exposed.

validation.note: SecurityWeek report citing ADM's notice and filings with the Texas and Vermont attorneys general.
